items.q: How is the money held in Escrow?
items.a: When a bid is accepted, the amount is held in a secure escrow account and is only released to the carrier after you confirm receipt of the shipment.
Every carrier undergoes full KYC verification: a valid commercial registration, an insurance policy, and approved transport licenses before being accepted on the platform.

items.q: Can I send a request to a specific carrier?
items.a: Yes. You can post the request to the open marketplace, or send it directly to a preferred carrier who can accept it or propose an alternative price.

items.q: When does the carrier get paid?
items.a: After delivery confirmation the amount is released automatically and reaches the carrier via bank transfer within the weekly payout cycle.
